data.name: Venktesh
data.gender_notes: Venktesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Venktesh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Venkata', which means 'hill' and 'Sesha', which means 'the last one'. The name Venktesh is a combination of these two words and refers to Lord Vishnu, who is often depicted sitting on a hill and is the last among the Gods. It is believed that the name Venktesh bestows strength, courage, and victory upon the bearer.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine presence of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
data.etymology: Venktesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Fort.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Venktesh total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
